metadata.scope: Training-only finite diagnosis; no PPO training, Validation/Test, SUMO, or model/config changes
metadata.kkt_runtime: project pure-Python fallback; optional Numba import disabled in this process only

candidate_selection_rule.uses_only: slot-0 legal target rows, GRU/forecast-scenario requests, predicted positions, existing 200-D economic feature; no realized task outcome or Matching/KKT value
candidate_selection_rule.geometry_zero_definition: raw expected request mass for added services >1e-12 and sum(demand_added_h0..h4) <=1e-10
candidate_selection_rule.control_definition: raw expected request mass >1e-12 and sum(demand_added_h0..h4) >1e-10
candidate_selection_rule.selection: one highest-raw zero-proxy and one highest-weighted positive control for each role; ties by episode, node ID, added IDs, target IDs, local candidate index; add requested RSU_1 service-2 anchor if legal
